# Decomposing three-month credit risk

This visual story starts with three-month forward default risk in a credit vintage, then follows the same observations through a sequential age-cohort-period decomposition and back to portfolio RD3M.

The data preparation is separate from the visualization. `prepare-data.R` creates static checked outputs under `data/`; the interactive renderer will only explain those precomputed results.
